content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text addresses a collision over Matthew 1:20 by setting the challenger's chain-based answer in [DR3] against the defender's chain-based answers in [CR2] and [CR3], which is the kind of chain-against-chain collision K-C governs.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"\"weighs chain against chain by footing\" — I weighed an explicit footing-by-footing recital versus a round-level comparison of each side's chain without verse-by-verse or stating-verse testing; the text fits the latter.","why":"The judge resolves the Matthew 1:20 collision by citing both sides' round-level chains and does not apply the retired stating-verse test or decide verse by verse."}
